arxiv-2302-04373.creator: Huixin Zhan, Kun Zhang, Keyi Lu, Victor S. Sheng
arxiv-2302-04373.description: Abstract In this paper, we measure the privacy leakage via studying whether graph representations can be inverted to recover the graph used to generate them via graph reconstruction attack (GRA). arxiv-2503-12179.title: Fitting regular point patterns with a hyperuniform perturbed lattice
arxiv-2503-12179.creator: Daniela Flimmel, Department of Probability, Mathematical Statistics, Charles University
arxiv-2503-12179.description: Abstract We introduce a flexible methodology for modelling regular spatial point patterns using hyperuniform perturbed lattices. We show that, under suitable mixing conditions on the displacement field, lattices perturbed by stationary random fields are hyperuniform in arbitrary dimension. In particular, Gaussian perturbations with absolutely summable covariances yield class-I hyperuniform point processes.

arxiv-2503-13107.title: ClearSight: Visual Signal Enhancement for Object Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv-2503-13107.creator: Hao Yin, Gunagzong Si, Zilei Wang
arxiv-2503-13107.description: Abstract Contrastive decoding strategies are widely used to mitigate object hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). By reducing over-reliance on language priors, these strategies ensure that generated content remains closely grounded in visual inputs, producing contextually accurate outputs. Since contrastive decoding requires no additional training or external tools, it offers both computational efficiency and versatility, making it highly attractive.
